# About

I'm a fourth year economics undergraduate at [Azim Premji University, Bengaluru](https://azimpremjiuniversity.edu.in/). My interests lie across labour economics, industrial organization, and econometrics.

I'm currently working on modelling labour market transitions in India, as part of my undergraduate thesis under [Prof. Rajendran Narayanan](https://azimpremjiuniversity.edu.in/people/rajendran-narayanan). I also work as a research assistant under [Prof. Chinmaya Kumar](https://chinmayakumar.com/).
